errors.gate_closed: {stage} is waiting for approval: {approvals}. Approve or waive them before moving forward.
errors.no_dispatcher: approvals cannot be decided right now: the dispatcher is not running
errors.open_limit: agents already asked for {max} approvals on this task that nobody has decided: wait for those before asking for more
errors.stage_requirement: {approval:%q} is required by the stage and cannot be removed: waive it instead, with a note
errors.unknown_stage: {stage:%q} is not a stage of this task's board
errors.stage_not_ahead: an approval can hold the current stage ({current}) or a later one that is not the last; {stage:%q} is not
errors.gate_closed_create: A new task starts in {stage}, which needs approval to leave: {approvals}. Create it in {stage} and move it once approved.
errors.required_checks: {approval:%q} waits for the checks GitHub requires before a merge: {checks}
errors.required_checks_waive: only an admin can waive {approval:%q} while the required checks are not green: {checks}
errors.gate_checks: {stage} waits for the checks GitHub requires before a merge, which {approvals} asks for: {checks}. The task can move on once they pass.

comments.approved_ahead_of_checks: **{approval}** approved while the checks GitHub requires still run: {checks}. The task stays in **{stage}** until they pass.
comments.reset_pushed: New commits on [PR #{number}]({url}) (head `{sha}`): **{approval}** goes back to pending. Approve it again once you have looked at them.

log.post_decision: post the decision of approval {approval} on task {task}
log.hook_task: read task {task} for an approval webhook
log.checks_root: read the parent of task {task} for its pull requests
log.checks_note: leave the required checks note on task {task}
log.checks_reset: send the approvals of task {task} back to pending after a push

checks.behind: the branch is behind its base, which must be up to date
checks.unknown: the required checks could not be read from GitHub; try again
